boundary: This is a public-source coverage assessment, not a product recommendation, return forecast, historical-performance result, account-suitability conclusion, portfolio allocation or order instruction.

coverage_matrix.finding: Current daily-contract fields plus dated listing/delisting/adjustment queries can support limited checks, but not a demonstrated complete historical as-of master.
The retained public market page is current-market labelled; the retained daily-contract query has no captured historical as-of parameter. No complete historical quote/depth/fill panel is evidenced.
coverage_matrix.required_component: Historical option close/settlement and decision-time bid/ask/depth panel

coverage_matrix.finding: Dated adjustment records can inform a manual cross-check, but they are not a normalized total-return, cash-flow or immutable timing ledger.
coverage_matrix.required_component: ETF distribution, option-adjustment and lifecycle mapping

coverage_matrix.finding: The historical-data product page is not a written delivery, usage right or accepted data contract.
coverage_matrix.required_component: Historical data rights, available-at/version chain and independent replay rights

coverage_matrix.finding: None of the retained public sources is an account, broker-routing, execution-cost or settlement record.
coverage_matrix.required_component: Broker/account eligibility, order state, fills, fees, settlement and cash movements

decision.reason: Do not select an ETF, contract, strike, expiry, size, broker, calendar or threshold. Any future formal C51 study still requires a user-authorized, written-rights delivery plus accepted point-in-time, total-return/event and execution evidence.

adjustment_event_example.not_established: A normalized ETF distribution, cash-flow, total-return or investor-settlement ledger.
adjustment_event_example.usable_for: An example that corporate-action mapping is economically material and must be retained in any later option lifecycle ledger.
adjustment_event_example.what_is_evidenced: The 2016-11-28 SSE notice says a 50ETF distribution would trigger adjustment of unexpired option contracts, including contract unit and prior-settlement adjustments and relisting of new contracts.

current_market_display.not_established: A public, date-queryable historical close or settlement panel, a historical bid/ask/depth tape, or an order/fill record.
current_market_display.what_is_evidenced: The retained SSE page is labelled '行情'.

daily_contract_display.bounded_interpretation: The retained public implementation supports a current-day contract view filtered by expiry and underlying. It is not evidence of a complete, immutable historical as-of contract-master archive. This is a statement about the captured query only; it does not claim that no other SSE route could exist.
daily_contract_display.what_is_evidenced: The SSE page is explicitly labelled '当日合约'. Its retained client query renders contract code, trading code, name, underlying, call/put, exercise price, unit, exercise/delivery/expiry dates, new-listing flag, price limits, prior settlement, adjustment and delisting fields.

historical_data_product_page.bounded_interpretation: This identifies a possible future licensed-data category only. It does not prove current written rights, a delivered field set, point-in-time version/available-at coverage, replay rights, account records or C48 closure.
historical_data_product_page.what_is_evidenced: The SSE information operator describes a historical-data product covering stock options and categories including snapshots, trades, daily/minute bars and reference files, with a business-application link.

listing_delisting_adjustment_disclosures.not_established: A normalized, complete point-in-time master; immutable versions or available-at history; full lifecycle completeness across every contract and date.
listing_delisting_adjustment_disclosures.usable_for: Dated, contract-event cross-checks and selected adjustment-event reconstruction.
listing_delisting_adjustment_disclosures.what_is_evidenced: The SSE '挂牌信息' page presents new-listing, delisting and adjustment sections, and its retained query implementation accepts adjustDate for each of those categories.

relationship_to_existing_controls.effect: C52 adds source-level precision to C51's historical-data gap. It does not close C48, alter C49's conditional future-route conclusion, reopen C13, or admit C51.

scope: A read-only coverage screen of retained public SSE pages and their client-side query implementation. It asks whether those pages close C51's historical data contract; it does not test, select or operate a collar or any other option position.

strict_hurdle_boundary.hurdle: Long-run annualized return above 5% is a research objective only, not a promise or guarantee.
strict_hurdle_boundary.reason: Public source coverage does not establish the history, total-return/event, execution/cost, account or rights inputs needed to calculate a net collar outcome.
